'''November 2004 Severna Park tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 27 November 2004 at 1 pm at the Severna Park Community Center in Severna Park, Maryland.<ref name="pcf-4138-56911">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=56911#56911 Two MD Locals back to back!], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 November 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050217013656/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=56911%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Tim Simon]] announced it on the Players Committee forum together with the [[December 2004 Fallston tournament|Fallston tournament]] of the following Saturday, 4 December 2004.<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Severna Park Community Center, Severna Park, Maryland<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />
* '''Dates:''' 27 November 2004<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />
* '''Time:''' 1 pm<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic.
